correctness.rationale: Eisenstein at a simple zero of Z^n-2ic proves irreducibility of F_c=Z^n-W^n-2ic for n≥2,c≠0. Equality of magnitudes on an open analytic arc implies divisibility by F_c, hence in its function field R(Z)R*(W)=1. The W→ζW automorphisms force R(z)=H(z^n), and the rational involution H(U)H*(U-2ic)=1 pairs every zero α with a pole barα+2ic; reduced nonconstant degrees are precisely nk. A second distinct level gives a nonzero rational period and forces H constant. The product of distinct F_c factors gives Hermitian kernel dimension max(0,d-nL+1)^2 and thus profile rank D_L; analytic evaluation independence yields optimal D_l-D_(l-1) linear-profile samples. Independently checked n=2,d=3 exact ranks 12 for one level and 16 for two, plus rational reflection identities. The linear sampling optimality is not a claim about nonlinear phaseless minimum.
